title: Developmental CA2 perineuronal net reduction restores social memory in Shank3 mutant mice.
abstract: Shank3B knockout mice show developmental and persistent short-term social recognition deficits with CA2 network aberrations. Developing CA2 shows excessive perineuronal nets (PNNs), greater semaphorin-3A sequestration and afferent overgrowth. Reducing PNN levels restores semaphorin-3A, afferent input and social recognition into adulthood and partially normalizes CA2 activity.
